```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

if (!exists("project_folder")) {
  project_folder <- getwd()
  pipeline_folder <- getwd()
  features_file <- "config/features.yaml"
  sample_file <- "config/samples.tsv"
}

source(file.path(pipeline_folder, "workflow", "scripts", "R", "report_helpers.R"))
```

## Overview

This report covers the **reference** module: preparation of the miRBase mature/hairpin
references (base adjustment and species filtering) and the Bowtie/STAR index builds used
by every downstream alignment step.

## mirDB species filtering

```{r mirdb-stats}
stats <- parse_mirdb_stats(file.path(project_folder, "results", "reference", "mirbase", "mirdb.stats"))
preview_table(stats, n = nrow(stats), caption = "Number of sequences before/after species filtering")
```

## Indices built

```{r index-check, results='asis'}
indices <- tibble::tribble(
  ~index, ~path,
  "Bowtie: tRNA",           "References/tRNA/bosTau8-tRNAs.fa.1.ebwt",
  "Bowtie: PhiX",           "References/phix/phix174.fa.1.ebwt",
  "Bowtie: mature",         "results/reference/mirbase/mature_basesAdjusted.fa.1.ebwt",
  "Bowtie: mature_species", "results/reference/mirbase/mature_basesAdjusted_species.fa.1.ebwt",
  "Bowtie: hairpin",        "results/reference/mirbase/hairpin_basesAdjusted.fa.1.ebwt",
  "Bowtie: hairpin_species","results/reference/mirbase/hairpin_basesAdjusted_species.fa.1.ebwt",
  "Bowtie: genome",         "References/ARS12/*.1.ebwt",
  "STAR: mature",           "results/reference/star_index/mature/chrName.txt",
  "STAR: mature_species",   "results/reference/star_index/mature_species/chrName.txt",
  "STAR: hairpin",          "results/reference/star_index/hairpin/chrName.txt",
  "STAR: hairpin_species",  "results/reference/star_index/hairpin_species/chrName.txt",
  "STAR: genome",           "results/reference/star_index/genome/chrName.txt",
)
indices$built <- file.exists(file.path(project_folder, indices$path)) |
  vapply(indices$path, function(p) length(Sys.glob(file.path(project_folder, p))) > 0, logical(1))
preview_table(indices, n = nrow(indices), caption = "Reference index build status")
```

## Runtime and resource usage

```{r runtime}
bench <- discover_benchmarks(project_folder, "reference")
runtime_table(bench, caption = "reference module: runtime and peak memory per rule")
resource_allocation_table(bench, "reference", project_folder,
                           caption = "reference module: allocated vs. actual resource usage")
```

```{r runtime-plot, fig.width=7, fig.height=3}
runtime_plot(bench, title = "reference module: total runtime per rule")
```
